title: Macotaur
summary: Apple Silicon C29 GPU miner and desktop app for Tari L1. Requires macOS 15 or later. The October 14 review found GUI v0.1.0 and core v0.2.0 downloads and BSD-3-Clause source. Releases are ad-hoc signed and not Apple notarized. No mining, installation or download execution was performed. No separate public sharing announcement was found; the actual discovery was the creator’s public repository inventory.
creator: big-chief-1889
cardSummary: Mine Tari C29 on Apple Silicon Macs with pool selection, power controls and a desktop dashboard.
